Bengal CM Warns MLA Over Remarks; MLA Claims Misunderstanding

West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has warned MLA Humayun Kabir against making provocative public statements. Kabir, who had reportedly supported a 'Gunda Control Bill' proposed by Adhikari's government, later clarified his remarks, stating they were aimed at criminals and not the Chief Minister or the BJP. The situation arose following alleged inflammatory comments by Kabir, leading to FIRs being filed.
